verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers MX's data connectivity, aggregation, webhooks, dashboard, and API features extensively, but contains no mention of data retention policies, user-initiated deletion controls, or consent/data-lifecycle management. Missing for 10: any documentation of retention periods, deletion APIs/endpoints, user consent revocation, or compliance controls (GDPR/CCPA-style deletion) — the axis clearly applies to a financial data aggregator handling sensitive PII, but no supporting evidence exists.
